rule: A pirate leader gathers unhired pirates until the group is large enough, marches out, holds, and returns (raid body is a placeholder); death and theft make local witness reports; calendar windows are checked by date; airship routes follow one world clock with irregular dock calls; regrowth touches a fixed number of chunks per tick. See the md note for the order of operations per cell.

data_fields.name: pirate_recruit_scale
data_fields.unit: probability per hire above three (1 in 1200)

cells.name: NPC pirate raid: gather, hire, march, return
cells.best_transferable_idea: A group that gathers before it marches, with recruiting that speeds up as the group grows.
cells.defect: raid body is a TODO (mod.rs:493); range comment says 10 km for 10000 units (mod.rs:386); 'once an hour' depends on an evaluation rate that was not read.

cells.name: Witness reports within a radius
cells.best_transferable_idea: A death or theft is a report that only the people within a radius hear, and they act on it later.
cells.defect: TODO: reports pushed to every NPC inbox (report.rs:35); the chunk structure the TODO asks for is the fix.

cells.name: Calendar windows by date
cells.best_transferable_idea: A seasonal window is a date range checked when asked, not a stored event.
cells.defect: Easter is a hand-picked range (calendar.rs:53), not the date; the list may stay stale across midnight if built once.

cells.name: Airship timetable and dock countdown
cells.best_transferable_idea: A route on one world clock, with dock calls spaced irregularly so a wait feels like a countdown.
cells.defect: lateness beyond 10 s is only logged; no correction (airship_ai.rs:240, 253).

cells.name: Regrowth clock with a per-tick budget
cells.best_transferable_idea: A slow regrowth clock that touches a fixed number of chunks each tick, so cost stays flat.
cells.defect: none found in the code read; refill is one global constant, not per zone.
